item.title: Yatte mo Derarenai Heya ni Tojikomerareta no de Hikitsuzuki Motto Yaru Hanashi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tily
  • 発売日: 2025-01-31
  • スコア: 6.16/10 (48 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ヤっても出られない部屋に閉じ込められたので引き続きもっとヤる話
  • 英語名: Yatte mo Derarenai Heya ni Tojikomerareta no de Hikitsuzuki Motto Yaru Hanashi

あらすじ

One day, the protagonist wakes up in an unfamiliar room. For some reason, a schoolmate from a higher pecking order, Akino Yuna, is next to him.

Still confused, he tries to look for a way out, but with no success. There are only white walls and a single bed, a room with nothing. At the same time, Akino Yuna wakes up, unable to hide her confusion as well.

item.title: Ano Hi no Kimi o Furimukasete.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tily
  • 発売日: 2024-11-29
  • スコア: 6.51/10 (34 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あの日の君を振り向かせて。
  • 英語名: Ano Hi no Kimi o Furimukasete.

あらすじ

One day, the protagonist, Naomichi, realizes that he’s time-leaping.

He doesn’t know why, but this must be a chance given to him by God!

He remembers his many failures and the girl he likes, Yuu.

If he corrects his mistakes one by one, maybe he’ll be able to “fall in love” with her!?
